us_shopper.label: US Shopper
us_shopper.notes: Default shopper-fidelity profile. DeepSeek verify runs backend-direct as an ungrounded answer-quality second opinion.

pilot_gemini.label: Pilot — Gemini citation + DeepSeek verify
pilot_gemini.notes: Phased pilot profile: isolate Gemini citation + DeepSeek answer-quality verify; ChatGPT added later via us_shopper once this phase validates.

gemini_deepseek.label: Gemini + DeepSeek (dual grounded)
gemini_deepseek.notes: Both run as primary grounded citation probers; results combine via MAX with per-provider drill-down. Validates the multi-LLM path before adding OpenAI/Claude.

gemini_deepseek_chatgpt.label: Gemini + DeepSeek + ChatGPT (tri grounded)
gemini_deepseek_chatgpt.notes: Wedge hero-SKU tri-prober: adds grounded ChatGPT (OpenAI Responses API + web_search_preview) as a co-equal primary. Gated on OPENAI_API_KEY in PIVOTA-Agent; without it ChatGPT returns mock_fallback_no_openai_key and is filtered by the per-SKU honesty guard, so it simply doesn't appear until the key is live. Hero-SKU only (free tier) — the brand report stays gemini_deepseek for cost.
